title: Manila Water schedules repairs in Taguig, Marikina, Rizal on Oct. 20-22

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — East zone concessionaire Manila Water has advised its customers to store enough water ahead of scheduled maintenance activities in parts of Taguig, Marikina, and Rizal from Tuesday, October 20 to Thursday, October 22.
